Important information

Safety Information

Do not swallow. Not intended for use by children who may put it in their mouths. Do not use for purposes other than oral hygiene.

Directions

1. Remove the toothbrush from its packaging. 2. Charge the toothbrush for at least 24 hours before use. 3. Attach the SimplyClean (C1) brush head to the toothbrush handle. 4. Wet the brush head and apply toothpaste. 5. Press the power button to turn on the toothbrush. 6. Brush for 2 minutes, using the SmarTimer and QuadPacer to ensure even brushing. 7. Rinse the brush head and toothbrush handle after use. 8. Charge the toothbrush after each use to ensure a long battery life. 9. Subscribe to brush head replacements to ensure optimal performance.

Product Description

Achieve better plaque removal than with a manual toothbrush thanks to the Philips Sonicare 1100 Series sonic toothbrush paired with the C1 Simply Clean electric toothbrush head. Enjoy a powerful yet gentle clean, even in those hard-to-reach areas. The Advanced Sonic Technology provides gentle yet effective cleaning, pulsing fluid between teeth and along the gumline. To help you get used to the Sonicare experience, the EasyStart feature adjusts the power level of the toothbrush over the first 14 uses. Improve your brushing technique with QuadPacer, which reminds you to brush each section of your mouth for 30 seconds, and reach your recommended brushing time of 2 minutes with SmarTimer. Experience up to 14 days of regular brushing after a single charge, bringing a new level of convenience to your brushing routine (based on two periods of two-minute brushings per day on standard mode). Dental professionals recommend changing brush heads every 3 months.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.
